test_title: PYST 47: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

And death and **__bereavement__** are hardly the only troubles that this conflict brings to a Palestinian childhood.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Comfort**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bereavement"** means the state of sorrow over the death or departure of a loved one. (शोक)

 
 
• **Example: **She has been struggling to cope with bereavement after her father's death.
 
 
 
• **"Comfort"** refers to a state of physical ease and freedom from pain or constraint. It also means consolation in a time of distress or sadness. (आराम)
 
 
• **Example: **She found comfort in the support of her friends during her tough times.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'bereavement' **is **'comfort'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Comfort**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Distress** (कष्ट): Extreme anxiety, sorrow, or pain.

 
 
• **Example:** The news of the accident caused her great distress.
 
 
 
• **Tribulation** (कठिनाई): A cause of great trouble or suffering.
 
 
• **Example:** They faced many tribulations during their journey.
 
 
 
• **Sorrow** (दुःख): A feeling of deep distress caused by loss, disappointment, or other misfortune.
 
 
• **Example:** Her sorrow was evident when she spoke about her late husband.
